title: project_meta
description: Project metadata for translation / editing workflows. Lives as loose-file `_meta.json` next to source.indd or in a package folder; later promoted into .txpkg by Phase 10. Canonical SoT (Phase 8D-ext-A0).

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Start at 1. Bumped only on required-field semantic changes.

project_id.description: Stable id, never changes after first creation. Format: slugify(project_name) + '-' + 16 hex chars (64-bit entropy).

source_language.description: BCP 47 tag of source content. Required. Structural validation per BCP 47 layer-1 grammar (separate fixture set).

target_language.description: BCP 47 tag of target content. May be null only when workflow_mode == 'edit-only'. Validated by conditional oneOf below.

workflow_mode.description: Project workflow phase. translation: src→tgt active translation. edit-only: single-lang editing pass. bilingual: parallel two-lang content without active translation pipeline.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. First-writer fills; never changes.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC. Updated on every semantic-mutating write (per round-trip rules: skip write when in-memory == disk excluding updated_at).

contributors.description: Project contributors recorded by ROLE (not a flat owner). Each role maps to a person name or null. Auto-attributed by tool/phase: webui translation work fills contributors.translator (name sourced from the browser convenience store's operator_name); InDesign export fills contributors.designer. Extensible with further roles (e.g. reviewer) later. Editable. Absent or all-null = no recorded contributors. (Phase 8D-ext-A0 roles refactor 2026-06-15, replaces flat assignee per user 2026-06-15: "web 处理的自动作为译者(translator)，InDesign 导出的自动作为设计师(designer)".)

translator.description: Translator (web/webui handler). Auto-filled from browser convenience store operator_name on webui translation work; null or absent = unrecorded.

designer.description: Designer (InDesign handler). Auto-filled on InDesign export; null or absent = unrecorded.

deadline.description: Project deadline, ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date-time. Editable. null or absent = none. (Phase 8D-ext-A0 field add 2026-06-15.)

oneOf.description: translation and bilingual require non-null target_language
